TestHandleLogsKeepsAnUndecodableBodyRaw/.why: The note quotes the JSON parser's error, and .NET's parser words it differently from Go's.

TestHandleAppV3KeepsUndecodableBodies__n.why: The note quotes the protobuf parser's error, and Google.Protobuf words it differently from Go's proto package.

TestHandleProcDiscoveryStoresRows/001.why: create_time of a discovery without a start time. Go hands clickhouse-go its zero time (year 1), and that driver writes it as the epoch. The .NET driver writes year 1 as it is into this DateTime64 column (and refuses it outright for the DateTime column of `processes`), so the F# table passes the epoch itself: what Go stored. The row's CreateTime (/sends/1/rows/1/CreateTime) is still Go's zero time and is compared.
